parameters.name: EgressNumFlows
parameters.description: The number of QoS flows that this interface has from the MoCA network. This parameter is based on ''mocaIfEgressNodeNumFlows'' from {{bibref|MOCA11-MIB}}.

parameters.name: IngressNumFlows
parameters.description: The number of QoS flows that this interface has onto the MoCA network. This parameter is based on ''mocaIfIngressNodeNumFlows'' from {{bibref|MOCA11-MIB}}.

object.description: The QoS object provides information on MoCA parameterized QoS for this interface {{bibref|MoCAv1.1}}.
